summary: Blue Moon Metals filed a Form 6-K reporting that its subsidiary Nye Sulitjelma Gruver AS entered into a binding share purchase agreement with VMS Explorations AS (a subsidiary of Alpha Future Funds) to combine their holdings in Norway's Sulitjelma mining district. Under the terms, VMS will acquire 100% of NSG for US$15 million payable in VMS shares, giving Blue Moon a 30% stake in the combined entity. The deal is arm's length, subject to a minimum C$10 million capital raise and listing of VMS on a recognized exchange within 18 months. Blue Moon must maintain its 30% pre-listing interest. The transaction consolidates copper-gold assets in a brownfield district with existing infrastructure. Watch for financing completion, regulatory approvals, and the listing timeline; no premium or break fee disclosed.
